sections.title: Intelligent Workflow Automation
sections.subtitle: Reusable workflow and integration patterns, adapted to your processes, rules and human approvals.

backgroundImage.alt: Connected network illustrating people, applications and AI tasks

sections.heading: Keep work moving across systems
sections.body:
Intelligent Workflow Automation is reusable delivery IP, not another standalone automation platform. Its workflow, AI orchestration and integration patterns are adapted to your process; discovery, system access and business rules remain client-specific.

It supports the [Intelligent Operations value play](/solutions/intelligent-operations), alongside [Automation & RPA](/services/digital-transformation/automation-rpa) and [Integration services](/services/digital-transformation/integration-services). [Assess your workflow](#get-in-touch): share the process, involved systems and desired outcome, not sensitive case records.

sections.heading: Automation from task to decision

items.title: Workflow automation
items.description: Adapt repeatable workflow patterns to your process steps, roles and exception paths.
items.bullets:
Inputs - task data and process rules
Configure - hand-offs, approvals and exceptions
Output - controlled task flow

items.title: AI orchestration
items.description: Place AI-supported tasks inside a workflow with defined context, permissions and human review.
items.bullets:
Inputs - permitted data and task context
Configure - AI boundaries and review points
Output - decision support for review

items.title: Application integration
items.description: Adapt integration patterns to the applications and interfaces in scope; connectors are selected during assessment.
items.bullets:
Inputs - system APIs and data contracts
Configure - mappings, access and failure handling
Output - information passed between systems

sections.note: Select the workflow, orchestration and integration assets for the process. The supported connectors, configurable rules and audit requirements are agreed for the engagement.

sections.heading: Build around the workflow that matters
sections.description: The framework contributes reusable patterns; the process design and acceptance evidence remain specific to your organisation.

items.title: Scoped process
items.description: Map the decision, process owner, baseline and exceptions.
items.bullets:
Reuse - relevant workflow patterns
Accept - process scope and baseline

items.title: Integration and approval design
items.description: Define system contracts, permissions and approval responsibilities.
items.bullets:
Tailor - interfaces and human controls
Accept - integration and approval design

items.title: Tested workflow
items.description: Test normal paths, incomplete inputs and failures before release.
items.bullets:
Tailor - rules and exception handling
Accept - workflow and exception evidence

items.title: Controlled release
items.description: Agree a release boundary and an operating handover with accountable owners.
items.bullets:
Tailor - deployment and operating runbook
Accept - release and handover criteria

sections.note: Document and data intake → completeness and policy checks → AI-supported assessment → an authorised underwriter approves or refers the case → exceptions return to a review queue. Underwriting optimisation is an applied BFSI use case, not an autonomous approval promise or a client case study.

sections.heading: What stays under human review?
sections.description: First value is a tested workflow in a controlled pilot. Integration access, process complexity and approval rules determine timing; reuse does not remove these dependencies.

items.title: Systems and process
items.description: Start with an owned, repeatable process and accessible interfaces.
items.bullets:
Provide - system/API access and data contracts
Name - process and rule owners
Agree - scope and baseline

items.title: Permissions and exceptions
items.description: Define what each task may access, recommend or change.
items.bullets:
Agree - data permissions and AI task boundaries
Name - human approval and escalation points
Test - failures, exceptions and audit trail

items.title: Operating ownership
items.description: Plan a controlled release and the responsibilities after go-live.
items.bullets:
Agree - deployment and security boundaries
Name - support and exception owners
Measure - cycle time or manual touches against an agreed baseline

sections.note: Accelerator adoption is scoped separately from software licensing. Agree the [engagement model](/company/our-approach#engagement-models), reuse and handover rights, licence dependencies and ongoing support before delivery.

sections.heading: Deliver intelligent operations together
sections.description: Linkworks supplies composable applications within the Intelligent Operations value play. Its role and any product licence are scoped separately from framework adoption.

items.title: Predictive Analytics Suite
